answers.core:
I think especialy the tile area related features are missing. When i began using godot and working with (back then) TileMaps i tried things like .fill_area() or .erase_area() to fill or erase areas of my TileMap. 
I think since the set_cell() and erase_cell() is a feature this should be in there too.

And the feature which obtains the cell transform flags should be in core aswell since the GDScript solution is kinda inintuitive and in some cases a must-have. 
I know multiple developers (me included) who are using work around functions made with GDScript to obtain the transform informations of a cell many times. I was browsing the web back then kinda long to get a good solution for my problem.
Having this in core would be fantastic and could enhances the TileMapLayer capabilities as well as workflow efficiency/ -speed.
answers.workaround:
All the functions reduce the amount of code you have to write.

For the two new area tile related functions you would normaly have to create a nested loop to get all tiles within an rect created by two points

The function which adds the ability to obtain the cell transform flags is a little more complex because an efficient approach uses bit wise operations
And in addition to that it's not that intuitive as other tile related functions. Especialy for beginners who are facing such an issue this comes realy handy
